reuse.why: Uses the existing recurConfigToRSchedule builder and the recurrence library's byDayOfWeek filter rather than adding new date logic.

duplication.why: A single conditional in one function; nothing is duplicated.

placement.why: The recurrence builder is where frequency-specific rules are expressed, though weekend handling is now split between it (daily skip) and the separate weekend-move helper.

scope.why: A four-line change confined to the rule.

maintainability.why: Very small and declarative; a maintainer has to know the daily skip lives in the rrule builder rather than beside the weekend-move code, and no test accompanies it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every RSchedule in the tree (getNextDate via rule-utils parseRecurDate, getUpcomingDates, find-schedules) is built through recurConfigToRSchedule.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts recurConfigToRSchedule, the single builder all schedule occurrence paths use.
